set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/image. Acceptance: separate world points from continuous voxel coordinates; introduce Affine3D as an invertible finite 4x4 value; add VolumeSpace/SeriesSpace or equivalent shape wrappers so 3D/4D spaces cannot be confused; make masks and ROI/sparse index sets validated values; stage typed overloads before removing raw Vector APIs. Verification: imageJVM/test and imageJS/test plus compile fallout in surface, spatial, atlas, threshold, motion, mvpa-spatial.
set.title: Type image coordinate frames, affines, spaces, and masks
